# Community Rules
These rules apply at all times, in-game, in the lobby, in the Discord, and on the GitHub.
## 0. Catch-All Clause The BoxStation staff team (Game Administrators and Discord Moderators) retain the right to issue bans or revoke the whitelist of players deemed a consistent net-negative to the community at large, even without any specific rules violations. - Do not engage in Rules Lawyering, however you may seek clarification in good faith.
## 1. English Speaking Community BoxStation is an English speaking community. Please speak primarily in English, and understand that conversations not in English may be asked to be moved.
## 2. No Bigotry Allowed [color=#ff0000](ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY)[/color]
No hate speech, no slurs, no bigotry. This is a Zero Tolerance Policy. This includes, but is not limited to: - Racism - Sexism - Ableism - Homophobia - Transphobia - etc.
This extends to in-universe behaviour and bigotry, such as speciesism.
## 3. Be Age Appropriate [color=#ff0000](ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY)[/color]
BoxStation is a 16+ space. As such, there is an expectation that all behavior both in-game and out of game within the BoxStation space is appropriate for that age range.
If you are found to be under 16 and playing on the server, you may be removed without warning or ability to appeal.
## 4. Don't Ban Evade [color=#ff0000](ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY)[/color]
Do not use alternate discord, ss14, or github accounts to circumvent administrative action. If you feel the need to appeal a permanent ban and removal from the server, please do this through a ticket in proxy through another trusted user.
## 5. Expectations of Privacy BoxStation is a semi-private whitelist only space with strict invite policies. - Do not share messages said by a member of the discord without their permission. - Do not livestream a round of BoxStation outside of private discord calls. - You may upload videos, but it is heavily encouraged to seek the opinions of those included in the video first.
## 6. Maintain a Respectful Environment We are all here to have fun, regardless of who we are or where we come from. Don’t forget that.
Be nice to each other, be constructive, and always remember the person playing the game.
